# dsh-turn-delete > 将活动会话的一个完整已关闭回合从模型上下文移除，保留原始事件。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/tree/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8)） - **版本日期**：2026-08-18（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码确认替换和拒绝条件，未独立运行。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：用户希望去掉一个错误回合并保留同一会话的后续进展。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 保留会话和后续轮次，缩小上下文更改范围。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 压缩跨度可能被拒绝，flush 失败后的重试需验证。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 对照新建会话测上下文保留与错误恢复。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先删除测试会话中间轮次，再验证重开。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 保留会话和后续轮次，缩小上下文更改范围。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 压缩跨度可能被拒绝，flush 失败后的重试需验证。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 对照新建会话测上下文保留与错误恢复。 确认压缩拒绝、flush 故障重试和重开，以及原始日志保留。 ## 场景与替代办法 用户希望去掉一个错误回合并保留同一会话的后续进展。 创建新会话并人工重建所需上下文。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容的 DSH Host 与 Web | 必需 | 使用活动 Agent 和 surface | 升级后需复验 | | 已关闭且独立的回合 | 操作必需 | 作为替换跨度 | 共享压缩节点时拒绝 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 定位 | 选择已关闭回合 | 检查是否依赖该回合 | | 操作 | 确认删除 | 核对可见结果 | | 复验 | 再次对话及重开 | 核对上下文和日志 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源未知 | 在可弃用会话验证 | 确认兼容版本 | | 持续 | 工时未知 | 判断回合与依赖 | 压缩后可能拒绝 | | 失败 | 恢复成本未知 | 保留日志并建立新会话 | 检查落盘状态 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 会话修正 | 跳过已知错误轮次 | 后续任务效果和节时 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：怎样让已关闭回合退出模型上下文并保留其余会话？ ### Q01 · 一次删除实际改变哪部分会话？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Web 请求以活动会话 ID 和助手消息 ID 定位目标，取得维护租约后追加空内容替换，并等待 flush。原始日志、会话 ID 和后续回合保留，所以该功能适合去掉当前模型上下文中的错误回合。与重新建会话相比，可保持剩余上下文；已经发生的外部工具副作用不会被此替换撤回。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/http.ts:95-124](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/http.ts#L95-L124) POST 接收和定位。
查看原文（30行） ```text export async function handleTurnDelete( ctx: Context, request: HttpRequestLike, response: HttpResponseLike, ): Promise { if (request.method !== 'POST') { response.writeHead(405, { allow: 'POST' }) response.end() return } const contentType = request.headers?.['content-type'] if (typeof contentType !== 'string' || !contentType.toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json')) { respondJson(response, 415, { ok: false, error: { code: 'INVALID_REQUEST', message: 'application/json required' } }) return } try { const input = decodeRequest(await requestJson(request)) const sessionId = SessionId(input.sessionId) const agent = ctx.agents.get(sessionId) if (agent === undefined) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TARGET_NOT_FOUND', `session "${input.sessionId}" is not active`) } const value = await deleteTurn(ctx, agent, MessageId(input.assistantMessageId)) respondJson(response, 200, { ok: true, value }) } catch (error: unknown) { if (error instanceof TurnDeleteError) { respondJson(response, error.code === 'AGENT_BUSY' ? 423 : 409, { ok: false, error: { code: error.code, message: error.message }, }) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/turn-delete.ts:151-177](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/turn-delete.ts#L151-L177) 空内容替换与维护租约。
查看原文（27行） ```text signal.throwIfAborted() const tombstone = session.append('assistant/message', { turn, step: target.data.step, message: createAssistantMessage({ content: [], source: { provider: TOMBSTONE_PROVIDER, model: TOMBSTONE_MODEL }, }), }, { surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start: selected[0] as number, end: selected.at(-1) as number }, sourceEventSeqs: selected, }) await ctx.sessions.flush(session) return { turn, seq: tombstone.seq } } export async function deleteTurn( ctx: Context, agent: Agent, assistantMessageId: MessageId, ): Promise { try { return await agent.runMaintenance(signal => deleteUnderMaintenance(ctx, agent, assistantMessageId, signal)) } catch (error: unknown) { if (error instanceof TurnDeleteError) throw error throw new TurnDeleteError('AGENT_BUSY', error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[README.md:41-52](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/README.md#L41-L52) 作者描述上下文及日志区别。
查看原文（12行） ```text - A trash action appears only on completed ordinary Session turns. Subagent transcripts do not expose it. - Deletion requires confirmation and is disabled while the Session is running. - The prompt, assistant messages, and tool records for the selected turn are removed from the Session's current model surface. - The Session id, title, workspace association, later turns, and original append-only event log remain intact. - A durable zero-content replacement event records the deletion. Reloading the page or restarting the profile preserves it. - Repeating the same request is idempotent. The plugin refuses deletion when the target turn is still open or has already been merged into a compaction replacement with other history. This prevents deleting only part of model-visible context. ## Design The Host half registers `POST /dsh-turn-delete`, claims the target Agent's maintenance lease, validates the complete closed-turn surface span, appends a zero-content replacement, and waits for `sessions.flush()` before acknowledging success. ```
#### 缺口 - 真实持久化和下次请求未独立复验 **影响**：无法证明宿主升级后仍保持行为 **进一步探讨**：准备三回合会话，删除中间项并比较模型输入与历史日志 ### Q02 · 什么情况下拒绝删除或出现未知持久化？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 缺目标、回合未结束、与压缩节点共享或目标跨度不连续时拒绝。已写入 tombstone 的同回合重复请求直接返回既有序号；若首调用 append 后 flush 抛错，重试可能命中内存事件并直接返回，而没有在这个分支重新 flush。这是源码显示的故障窗口，需确认宿主是否随后另行落盘。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/turn-delete.ts:95-121](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/turn-delete.ts#L95-L121) 活动会话、幂等与已关闭边界。
查看原文（27行） ```text const session = agent.session if (ctx.sessions.get(session.id) !== session) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TARGET_NOT_FOUND', `session "${session.id}" is no longer live`) } const events = session.events const target = events.find((event): event is SessionEvent<'assistant/message'> => event.type === 'assistant/message' && isAppendSurfaceEvent(event) && event.data.message.id === assistantMessageId) if (target === undefined) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TARGET_NOT_FOUND', `assistant message "${assistantMessageId}" was not found`) } const turn = target.data.turn const existing = events.find(event => isTurnDeleteEvent(event) && event.data.turn === turn) if (existing !== undefined) return { turn, seq: existing.seq } const bracket = turnBracket(events, turn, target.seq) if (bracket === undefined) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_NOT_CLOSED', `turn ${String(turn)} is not closed`) } const originSeqs = new Set(events .filter(event => isAppendSurfaceEvent(event) && originBelongsToTurn(event, turn, bracket)) .map(event => event.seq)) const currentNodes = session.surface.nodes if (!currentNodes.includes(target.seq)) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} is no longer independently deletable`) ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/turn-delete.ts:124-148](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/turn-delete.ts#L124-L148) 压缩和跨度条件。
查看原文（25行） ```text const memo = new Map>() const selected: number[] = [] const covered = new Set() for (const seq of currentNodes) { const origins = surfaceOrigins(seq, events, memo) const targetOrigins = [...origins].filter(origin => originSeqs.has(origin)) if (targetOrigins.length === 0) continue if ([...origins].some(origin => !originSeqs.has(origin))) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} shares a compacted surface node`) } const current = events[seq] if (current !== undefined && !originSeqs.has(seq) && !(current.type === 'tool/result' && current.data.turn === turn)) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} contains a non-local replacement`) } selected.push(seq) for (const origin of targetOrigins) covered.add(origin) } if ([...originSeqs].some(origin => !covered.has(origin)) || selected.length === 0) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} is partially compacted`) } const positions = selected.map(seq => currentNodes.indexOf(seq)) const first = positions[0] if (first === undefined || positions.some((position, index) => position !== first + index)) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} is not a contiguous surface span`) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/turn-delete.ts:151-177](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/turn-delete.ts#L151-L177) 追加后等待持久化。
查看原文（27行） ```text signal.throwIfAborted() const tombstone = session.append('assistant/message', { turn, step: target.data.step, message: createAssistantMessage({ content: [], source: { provider: TOMBSTONE_PROVIDER, model: TOMBSTONE_MODEL }, }), }, { surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start: selected[0] as number, end: selected.at(-1) as number }, sourceEventSeqs: selected, }) await ctx.sessions.flush(session) return { turn, seq: tombstone.seq } } export async function deleteTurn( ctx: Context, agent: Agent, assistantMessageId: MessageId, ): Promise { try { return await agent.runMaintenance(signal => deleteUnderMaintenance(ctx, agent, assistantMessageId, signal)) } catch (error: unknown) { if (error instanceof TurnDeleteError) throw error throw new TurnDeleteError('AGENT_BUSY', error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)) ```
#### 缺口 - 未注入 flush 错误或服务重启 **影响**：重复成功响应与落盘是否一致未知 **进一步探讨**：让 flush 失败后同进程重试并重开读取日志 ### Q03 · 什么时候值得用此功能处理误导上下文？ **研究主题**：采用判断、效果与总成本、新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 在可弃用会话对照新开会话和回合删减，先记录工具副作用与保留的后续任务信息。验收删除中间回合后的新请求、压缩拒绝和进程重启。若目的是删除敏感日志或撤销工具操作，当前行为不满足，应沿独立日志和恢复流程。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:43-62](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/README.md#L43-L62) 作者的保留范围及三回合复核建议。
查看原文（20行） ```text - The prompt, assistant messages, and tool records for the selected turn are removed from the Session's current model surface. - The Session id, title, workspace association, later turns, and original append-only event log remain intact. - A durable zero-content replacement event records the deletion. Reloading the page or restarting the profile preserves it. - Repeating the same request is idempotent. The plugin refuses deletion when the target turn is still open or has already been merged into a compaction replacement with other history. This prevents deleting only part of model-visible context. ## Design The Host half registers `POST /dsh-turn-delete`, claims the target Agent's maintenance lease, validates the complete closed-turn surface span, appends a zero-content replacement, and waits for `sessions.flush()` before acknowledging success. The browser half contributes to the public `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` and `conversation.chat.turnTail` slots. A Conversation definition projects the durable tombstone onto the target Turn. DeepSeek Harness does not yet expose a public whole-Turn visibility hook, so the tail contribution applies a narrow presentation compatibility layer to the Chat rows between adjacent Turn tails. Model context deletion does not depend on that compatibility layer. ## Compatibility - DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.1.0-rc.7` - Node.js 22.19 or newer - Web profile and Web-based desktop shells DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview. After upgrading Harness, verify the plugin once with a disposable Session containing three short turns and delete the middle one. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/turn-delete.ts:145-164](https://github.com/hanshenmesen/dsh-turn-delete/blob/4716bcbdee27b110ceea9df21f027c6dfe5888b8/src/turn-delete.ts#L145-L164) 有界替换和 flush。
查看原文（20行） ```text const positions = selected.map(seq => currentNodes.indexOf(seq)) const first = positions[0] if (first === undefined || positions.some((position, index) => position !== first + index)) { throw new TurnDeleteError('TURN_COMPACTED', `turn ${String(turn)} is not a contiguous surface span`) } signal.throwIfAborted() const tombstone = session.append('assistant/message', { turn, step: target.data.step, message: createAssistantMessage({ content: [], source: { provider: TOMBSTONE_PROVIDER, model: TOMBSTONE_MODEL }, }), }, { surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', start: selected[0] as number, end: selected.at(-1) as number }, sourceEventSeqs: selected, }) await ctx.sessions.flush(session) return { turn, seq: tombstone.seq } ```
